name: Jiniya Addons
author: jiniyaaddons

sections.description:
Jiniya Addons is a modern, lightweight, and powerful Elementor Addons plugin that helps you create professional and responsive WordPress websites with ease.

The plugin works seamlessly with Elementor Page Builder and supports WooCommerce and all WordPress themes. Using simple drag & drop controls, you can build custom layouts, sections, and content without writing any code.

Jiniya Addons is suitable for beginners as well as advanced users who want clean design, flexibility, and optimized performance.

Available Widgets

Dual Button
When you need two buttons side by side, simply drag this widget and easily customize the design.

Single Button
Create fully customizable buttons with hover effects and styling options.

Advanced Heading
Create stylish headings with custom typography and color controls.

Info Box
Display icon, title, and description to highlight features or services.

Icon Box
Add icons with text and customize size, color, and layout easily.

Image Box
Combine image and text for attractive content blocks.

Call To Action
Create engaging call-to-action sections to increase conversions.

Testimonial
Show customer reviews with name, image, and rating.

Testimonial Carousel
Display multiple testimonials in a responsive slider layout.

Team Member
Show team members with photo, name, position, and social links.

Pricing Table
Create modern and responsive pricing tables.

Image Gallery
Display images in a responsive gallery layout.

Image Carousel
Create image sliders with navigation options.

Countdown Timer
Create urgency for offers or events.

Progress Bar
Show skills or statistics using animated progress bars.

Accordion
Organize content in collapsible sections.

Tabs
Create tab-based content layouts.

Alert Box
Display important notices or messages.

Social Icons
Add social media icons with custom styles.

Counter
Show animated number counters.

Post Grid
Display blog posts in a responsive grid.

Woo Product Grid
Display WooCommerce products in a clean grid layout.

Woo Product Carousel
Show WooCommerce products in a slider layout.
sections.installation:
1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Jiniya Addons”
  4. Click Install and Activate
  5. Open Elementor Editor and start using the widgets
sections.faq:
Is Jiniya Addons free?

Yes, Jiniya Addons is completely free.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No, it works perfectly with Elementor Free.

Does it support all themes?

Yes, it supports almost all WordPress themes.
